verdict.rationale: Jan explicitly advertises a 'Custom Assistants' feature for creating specialized AI assistants for specific tasks, repeated consistently across GitHub README listings. However, there is no documentation detail on configuration options (system prompts, tools, model bindings per assistant) or independent/hands-on corroboration of this feature working as described. Missing for 10: detailed configuration docs for assistant customization, independent/hands-on verification, and community confirmation of the feature's depth.
